climate.koppen_name: Temperate, no dry season, warm summer

blurb.text: A cru village in the Côte des Blancs, and its champagnes carry the term blanc de blancs. Champagne's rules allow Chardonnay, Pinot Noir and Meunier, plus a few other grapes.

ISRIC SoilGrids 2.0, 1 km aggregates, 30 to 60 cm depth (CC BY 4.0)
